problem: A disinfectant reservoir in a water treatment facility can hold up to $200\,\text{gal}$ of liquid. Initially, it contains $50\,\text{gal}$ of disinfectant solution with $10\,\text{lb}$ of dissolved disinfectant. A more concentrated solution with concentration $0.8\,\text{lb/gal}$ flows into the reservoir at a rate of $15\,\text{gal/min},$ while the completely mixed solution drains out at a rate of $10\,\text{gal/min}.$ Rounded to one decimal place, find the amount of disinfectant in the reservoir at the moment it begins to overflow.
